reviews.author: Carol Staton
reviews.text: This company has a great crew. They took 10 trees out. One over a hundred feet tall against the utility lines. They left the yard in pristine order. No debris, limbs, leaves were left. They ground out all the stumps and hauled all debris away. I would highly recommend Tree Cutters to anyone looking for reliable, courteous workers at a fair price.

reviews.author: Lindsey Cox
reviews.text: Tree Cutters was very professional, reasonably priced, quick to respond, and left our yard clean and tidy. We had a huge oak tree in our backyard. It was struck by lightning several years ago and Tree Cutters were the only service who offered to help us try to save it rather than cut it down. Thanks to them, it held strong for a few more years. Unfortunately, after Helene, the tree split so severely that there was no way to save it. We called Tree Cutters again to take the tree down. I was devastated to see it go, but this crew was so understanding and sympathetic. It seemed like they were sad to have to take it down, which I really appreciated. They worked with me to leave behind some pieces of the tree for future projects, including some special cuts that were difficult to make. They were so patient and respectful of our property and our tree. I highly recommend Tree Cutters whether you're looking to quickly get rid of a nuisance tree or you're devastated to get rid of a beautiful, but dying tree.

reviews.author: tommie watson
reviews.text: I've had a dozen companies over the past 2 years come out and look at my situation and none of them wanted to take on my hill; as my yard is very steep and can be unforgiving if something gets out of control. I have over a dozen trees on the ground ranging from 1' to 3' in diameter and approximately 50' to 75' long that needed to be cut into sections that I could manage. Tree Cutters came promptly and did exactly what I needed and didn't rip me on the costs. I have more down on the other side of the yard that I will absolutely have Michael and his crew come back and take care of. I will, with no hesitation, recommend them to anyone who needs help with their trees.
